# Code Camp

> > Code Camp is Australia's leading provider of coding, Minecraft, and Roblox education programs for kids through holiday camps and after-school classes.

Code Camp partners with primary and secondary schools across Australia to deliver STEM-focused coding education using game-based learning methodologies. Programs include both in-person after-school classes and online sessions through Code Camp World, with live tutor support for students learning JavaScript, game design, and computational thinking.

## Key Topics

- Code Camp World
- STEM education
- After-school programs

## Main Programs & Offers

- [Code Camp | Australia's favourite holiday & after-school fun!](https://www.codecamp.com.au): Homepage for Australia's leading kids coding, Minecraft, and Roblox camps
- [Online After-School Programs](https://www.codecamp.com.au/online-after-school-programs-copy): 8-week online coding program with Code Camp World and live tutor support
- [Free Online Code Camp](https://www.codecamp.com.au/offers/free-online-code-camp): Free online coding session with Code Camp World and live tutor support
- [Drone Camp Trial](https://www.codecamp.com.au/offers/drone-camp-trial): Free Drone Camp trial for 9-13 year olds in South Australia
- [Referral Program](https://www.codecamp.com.au/why-code-camp/referral-program): Code Camp referral program with HP Chromebook prize draw and discounts

## Educational Resources & Blog

- [Why do we use game design to teach kids to code?](https://www.codecamp.com.au/blog/why-game-design): Game-based learning methodology for engaging kids in coding education
- [Is It Safe to Use Roblox and Minecraft for Learning?](https://www.codecamp.com.au/blog/roblox-minecraft-safety-for-kids): Safety guide for Roblox and Minecraft in educational settings for kids
